sources.title: Covering relations for multidimensional dynamical systems
sources.reviewed: Author preprint dated April 20, 2004: Theorem 9, printed page 11; Theorem 16, printed page 17; surrounding definitions and Corollary 12.
sources.relationship: Established closed-chain existence and one-exit covering criteria used in the proof. The present finite inequalities are instance-specific, not a new theorem or chaos mechanism.

sources.title: Analysis of crystallographic phase retrieval using iterative projection algorithms
sources.reviewed: Abstract; Sections 2.1.3-2.2, including equations 4-6; Sections 6-7 and Figure 7 caption.
sources.relationship: RAAR algebra and persistent fluctuations in reflected phase-retrieval trajectories predate this study. Their constraints are Fourier amplitudes, solvent flatness and histogram matching; no identification with this three-coordinate posterior recurrence was found in the reviewed sections.
sources.access_limit: Figure 7 image URL was discovered, but the direct image request returned HTTP 403; no visual comparison or full experiment reproduction.

scope: Bounded supplementary review. No claim of exhaustive historical search, nonlinear inequivalence or first discovery. Search result absence is not evidence of uniqueness.
